fields.title: Calculate and reduce costs
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Feature: input 5,000 tokens, output 400. Input price 15 ₽ per million, output 60 ₽ per million. 8,000 calls per day. 3,200 tokens of the input are immutable instruction and structure.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: Three levers and the effect of each.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: call = 5,000×0.000015 + 400×0.00006 = 0.075 + 0.024 = 0.099 ₽. Per year: 0.099 × 8,000 × 365 ≈ 289 thousand ₽. Levers: prompt caching on 3,200 immutable tokens — saves about half the input cost; trimming retrieved context; checking if the result depends on the user — if not, compute in advance and cache the response. The latter potentially cuts cost by an order of magnitude.
